news_signals.headline: Meta Platforms and Alphabet report Q2 earnings Tuesday July 29 - AI capex guidance expected to exceed $20B combined quarterly spend
news_signals.why: Every dollar of hyperscaler AI capex eventually becomes a GPU order. Meta and Alphabet confirming record AI infrastructure spend validates NVDA's Blackwell GPU order book for the next 4-6 quarters and triggers analyst estimate upgrades.

news_signals.headline: Bitcoin reclaims $105k level Sunday July 26, ETF inflows hit $820M for the week ended July 25
news_signals.why: MSTR's NAV premium expands when BTC is trending up with institutional ETF buying. $820M weekly ETF inflows signal sustained institutional demand that historically precedes 10-15% BTC price appreciation over the following 2 weeks.

news_signals.headline: Department of Defense releases FY2027 AI acquisition roadmap citing quantum computing as Tier 1 priority with $3.2B budget allocation
news_signals.why: As the only publicly traded pure-play quantum computing company, IONQ captures the entire quantum computing narrative when DoD signals massive budget commitment. This directly expands IONQ's total addressable market for government contracts.

news_signals.headline: FDA Advisory Committee for RNAi cardiovascular therapies holds review - plozasiran label discussion ongoing
news_signals.why: The 9-3 AdCom vote in June already established favorable FDA sentiment. Any additional positive commentary from the label discussion process increases approval probability heading into the August 8 PDUFA date.

news_signals.headline: SoundHound AI announces expansion of voice AI deployment to 8,000 additional restaurant locations with major fast food chain
news_signals.why: Restaurant AI deployments are SOUN's highest-volume revenue stream. 8,000 locations represents approximately $12-15M in annualized incremental revenue and validates the commercial scaling story ahead of August 7 earnings.

news_signals.headline: Consumer credit delinquency rates fall to 18-month low in June 2026 - Federal Reserve data
news_signals.why: UPST's AI lending model performance is directly tied to credit quality trends. Falling delinquencies mean existing loan books are performing better than modeled, which reduces loan loss provisions and improves Q2 profitability - directly supporting the earnings beat thesis.

daily_wisdom: The market rewards patience in entry and ruthlessness in exit. You waited for the setup, you sized it right, now the only job left is to take the money when the chart hands it to you. The traders who lose on great setups are the ones who refused to sell at their target because they wanted more. Take half. Move your stop to breakeven. Let the rest run. That is how you stay in the game for thirty years.
